l1_solar_wind.source: NOAA SWPC RTSW 1-minute solar wind and IMF (json/rtsw/rtsw_wind_1m.json, rtsw_mag_1m.json)
l1_solar_wind.why: GAU-15: an L1 sample (or its propagated arrival at Earth) older than this is not current; ingest stops carrying it and every surface shows it stale.

kp_estimated_1m.source: NOAA SWPC running planetary Kp estimate (json/planetary_k_index_1m.json)
kp_estimated_1m.why: The estimate updates every minute, so one older than the L1 bound has stopped updating; the last completed 3-hour Kp is used instead.

kp_planetary_3h.cadence: 3 h, stamped with the interval start
kp_planetary_3h.why: A completed interval is published after it ends and lags a rising storm by up to 3 h; 6 h after its start it no longer describes now.

dst_kyoto.source: Kyoto WDC quicklook Dst via NOAA SWPC (products/kyoto-dst.json)
dst_kyoto.why: GAU-116: hourly values, so past one missed hour the reading is unknown and the modelled Dst is used.

goes_particles.source: NOAA SWPC GOES primary integral protons and electrons (json/goes/primary/integral-{protons,electrons}-6-hour.json)
goes_particles.why: GAU-112: GOES publishes every 5 min; after several missed files the flux is unknown, not current.

goes_xray.source: NOAA SWPC GOES primary X-ray irradiance, 0.1-0.8 nm band (json/goes/primary/xrays-6-hour.json)
goes_xray.why: A flare rises in minutes, so an older X-ray reading cannot set the R-scale.

noaa_scales.source: NOAA SWPC latest observed R/S/G scales (products/noaa-scales.json)
noaa_scales.why: GAU-136: a cross-check only; older NOAA scales are not compared with Gauss's own levels.

esa_swarm_hapi.cadence: 1 Hz samples, published hours behind real time
esa_swarm_hapi.source: ESA VirES HAPI, Swarm A FAST magnetic field (SW_FAST_MAGA_LR_1B)
esa_swarm_hapi.why: GAU-63: Swarm FAST runs hours behind; a newest sample older than a day is not current.

mms_fgm_l2.cadence: archival survey L2, published weeks behind real time
mms_fgm_l2.source: NASA CDAWeb HAPI, MMS FGM survey L2 field in GSM (mms[1-4]_fgm_b_gsm_srvy_l2_clean)
mms_fgm_l2.why: GAU-63: older than 90 d the reconnection vector would describe a different season, so the source is not reported healthy.
